The #1 Claude skill on skills.sh has 4.5M installs, and most Claude users have never heard of it 👀

Find Skills (built by Vercel):
• you type what you're working on
• it searches the whole open skills directory
• picks the best skills for that exact task
• and installs them straight into your setup

One command, no hunting through GitHub.

Comment "SKILLS" and I'll DM you the GitHub repo
